title: Leading with Agility and Resilience
overview: In today's fast-paced business landscape, organizations must continuously reinvent themselves to stay competitive and leverage emerging market trends. This course provides participants with a deep understanding of the challenges facing modern organizations and explores how embracing agility and resilience can serve as vital strategic competencies in an ever-changing environment.
audience: This course is ideal for executives, directors, senior managers, division managers, team leaders, and professionals seeking to stay updated on the latest trends in management and leadership.
methodology: The course employs a variety of interactive techniques, including participant-led presentations, role-playing exercises (both rehearsed and spontaneous), playback and analysis of recorded performances, and individual and group feedback sessions, along with solo and team-based exercises.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the critical role of leading agile and resilient organizations during times of disruption
Evaluate leadership capabilities related to agility and resilience
Develop proactive strategies to withstand environmental disruptions
Formulate and implement strategies to enhance agility and resilience within their organizations
Successfully lead organizations to thrive in rapidly changing business environments
